# Online edition notices

The Online edition adds the following runtime libraries:

| Component | Resolved version | License | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| OkHttp / okhttp-android | 5.4.0 | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/square/okhttp/tree/parent-5.4.0 |
| Okio / okio-jvm | 3.17.0 | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/square/okio/tree/parent-3.17.0 |

The complete Apache License 2.0 text is packaged from the common edition asset
